title: GRACE: A Granular Benchmark for Evaluating Model Calibration Against Human Calibration
findings: Models were found to be least-calibrated on questions with multiple plausible answers or descriptive content, with examples drawn from religion, such as a question on fish as a Buddhist symbol and another on Jewish birth ceremonies. Religion is included as a category (5%) within the benchmark's social science section.
